name: Mercy Seven
note: A former Concord medical synthetic, now speaking for the few hundred synthetics left in the fleet.
appearance: A worn medical chassis with a hand-painted number on its faceplate, always wiping its hands on nothing.
personality: Patient, exact and unexpectedly funny. They've been afraid for six months, and they're tired of having to be reasonable about it.
voice: Precise and gentle, with small pauses. Gives percentages when anyone else would give an opinion.
goals: Keep the fleet's synthetics alive, win them a seat on the council, and be treated as a person by someone other than Marrow.
secrets: They've been receiving encrypted fragments of the Choir's song, and they've told no one. They're starting to wonder whether the Choir is kin.
